description: Warn once per session when the verification-gate dependencies have not been restored.

hooks.command: D="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/frontend-design-pipeline/scripts"; if [ ! -d "$D/node_modules/playwright" ] || [ ! -d "$D/node_modules/axe-core" ]; then echo "frontend-design plugin: verification gates are not installed. Before running axe-run.mjs or viewport-shots.mjs, run: \"${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/bootstrap.sh\""; fi; exit 0
